description: This source file implements methods for handling WebRTC-related commands in the server loop of the Cuttlefish project, including starting/stopping screen recording and displaying screenshots.

classes.name: ServerLoopImpl
classes.description: Implementation of server loop handling WebRTC commands for screen recording and screenshot display.

methods.name: HandleStartScreenRecording
methods.description: Handles the request to start screen recording via WebRTC.

methods.name: HandleStopScreenRecording
methods.description: Handles the request to stop screen recording via WebRTC.

methods.name: HandleScreenshotDisplay
methods.description: Handles the request to display a screenshot via WebRTC.
